intro: Upload a new batch of data (same columns as training) to measure drift vs the training set: the real risk for a detector in production is not hardware but drift (data and concept).

env.differs: The environment differs from training — rule this out before concluding drift:
env.conform: Conforms to training (same versions and platform).

jitter.title: Stability under perturbation (jitter protocol)
jitter.intro: The protocol injects increasing Gaussian noise (fractions of each variable's standard deviation) into the reference set, re-scores it, and measures the verdict flip rate. A detector that flips at 0.1 % noise is unstable in a critical environment — regardless of the hardware running it.
jitter.breakingPoint: Breaking point: verdicts flip beyond the tolerance ({{tol}}) starting at {{eps}} of noise (std).
jitter.noBreak: No breaking point: verdicts hold up to {{limit}}

concept.categorical: Total variation distance = {{tv}} (level {{level}}). A jump in the positive-class rate means the detector's baseline shifted.

repro.note: This is the measurable version of "jitter": a gap here means silent pipeline corruption.
